# ADR-3238: AWS secrets: Documented static API key for SaaS vendor 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some vendors only offer static keys.

## Decision

Integrations MAY adopt a documented static API key for SaaS vendor 6 (AWS-secrets-6) when the vendor lacks OAuth.

## Consequences

Keys rotate on a documented cadence.
